name: Tochnaja data sobytij v lagere "Sovjonok" ili progulka s Violoj
original_name: Точная дата событий в лагере "Совёнок" или прогулка с Виолой
source: For a long time, I was wondering what year the events of the game took place in the original script. I spent a long time digging through the Internet. I think I found it on Ychan that the date of the events was August 1989. Moreover, many disputed this date and suggested their own. In their disputes, the Ychans referred to the full moons to prove their own case. It was this clue that became decisive, and I had the idea to conduct an investigation. Having dug up the script from beginning to end, I found some clues that somehow hinted at the date of the events of the game. Fortunately, I had a special astronomical program for analyzing the full moons. Having compared all the data, I came to the conclusion about the exact date of the events.
translation: 很长一段时间，我都想知道原剧本中游戏中的事件发生在哪一年。我花了很长时间在互联网上挖掘。我想我在Ychan上发现事件发生的日期是1989年8月。此外，许多人对这个日期提出异议，并提出了自己的日期。在他们的争论中，Ychan夫妇用满月来证明他们自己的观点。正是这条线索起了决定性的作用，我萌生了进行调查的想法。从头到尾挖掘剧本后，我发现了一些线索，以某种方式暗示了游戏事件的发生日期。幸运的是，我有一个特殊的天文程序来分析满月。比较了所有数据后，我得出了事件发生的确切日期的结论。
